<link href="https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=DM+Serif+Display:ital@0;1&family=DM+Sans:wght@300;400;500&display=swap" rel="stylesheet">

<style>
  .contact-wrap {
    max-width: 760px;
    margin: 4rem auto;
    padding: 0 2rem;
  }

  .contact-eyebrow {
    font-size: 0.82rem;
    font-weight: 600;
    letter-spacing: 0.18em;
    text-transform: uppercase;
    color: var(--np-green, #2e7d60);
    margin-bottom: 0.6rem;
  }

  .contact-title {
    font-family: 'DM Serif Display', serif;
    font-size: 2.4rem;
    color: var(--np-navy, #1a3a5c);
    margin: 0 0 1rem;
    line-height: 1.15;
  }

  .contact-intro {
    font-size: 1rem;
    color: var(--np-text-soft, #444);
    line-height: 1.8;
    max-width: 580px;
    margin-bottom: 2.5rem;
  }

  /* ── Contact cards grid ── */
  .contact-grid {
    display: grid;
    grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fill, minmax(210px, 1fr));
    gap: 1.2rem;
    margin-bottom: 3rem;
  }

  .contact-card {
    border: 1.5px solid var(--np-border, #e0e6ed);
    border-radius: 10px;
    padding: 1.4rem 1.2rem;
    background: var(--np-bg, #fff);
    text-decoration: none;
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    gap: 0.5rem;
    transition: box-shadow 0.2s, border-color 0.2s, transform 0.2s;
  }

  .contact-card:hover {
    border-color: var(--np-navy, #1a3a5c);
    box-shadow: 0 6px 20px rgba(26,58,92,0.1);
    transform: translateY(-2px);
    text-decoration: none;
  }

  .contact-card-icon {
    font-size: 1.5rem;
    line-height: 1;
  }

  .contact-card-label {
    font-size: 0.74rem;
    font-weight: 700;
    letter-spacing: 0.14em;
    text-transform: uppercase;
    color: var(--np-green, #2e7d60);
  }

  .contact-card-value {
    font-size: 0.92rem;
    font-weight: 500;
    color: var(--np-navy, #1a3a5c);
    word-break: break-all;
  }

  .contact-card-sub {
    font-size: 0.82rem;
    color: var(--np-text-muted, #888);
  }

  /* ── Open to section ── */
  .open-to {
    border-top: 1px solid var(--np-border, #e0e6ed);
    padding-top: 2rem;
    margin-top: 1rem;
  }

  .open-to h2 {
    font-family: 'DM Serif Display', serif;
    font-size: 1.3rem;
    color: var(--np-navy, #1a3a5c);
    margin: 0 0 1.2rem;
  }

  .open-to-grid {
    display: grid;
    grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fill, minmax(200px, 1fr));
    gap: 0.75rem;
  }

  .open-to-item {
    display: flex;
    align-items: flex-start;
    gap: 0.7rem;
    padding: 0.9rem 1rem;
    background: var(--np-bg-soft, #f5f8fb);
    border-radius: 8px;
    border: 1px solid var(--np-border, #e0e6ed);
  }

  .open-to-item .oti-icon {
    font-size: 1.1rem;
    flex-shrink: 0;
    margin-top: 0.05rem;
  }

  .open-to-item .oti-text {
    font-size: 0.9rem;
    color: var(--np-text-soft, #444);
    line-height: 1.5;
  }

  .open-to-item .oti-text strong {
    display: block;
    color: var(--np-navy, #1a3a5c);
    font-weight: 600;
    margin-bottom: 0.1rem;
  }

  /* Dark mode */
  [data-theme="dark"] .contact-title { color: var(--np-navy) !important; }
  [data-theme="dark"] .contact-intro { color: var(--np-text-soft) !important; }
  [data-theme="dark"] .contact-card  {
    background: var(--np-bg) !important;
    border-color: var(--np-border) !important;
  }
  [data-theme="dark"] .contact-card:hover { border-color: var(--np-navy) !important; }
  [data-theme="dark"] .contact-card-value { color: var(--np-navy) !important; }
  [data-theme="dark"] .contact-card-sub   { color: var(--np-text-muted) !important; }
  [data-theme="dark"] .open-to h2         { color: var(--np-navy) !important; }
  [data-theme="dark"] .open-to-item       {
    background: var(--np-bg-soft) !important;
    border-color: var(--np-border) !important;
  }
  [data-theme="dark"] .open-to-item .oti-text         { color: var(--np-text-soft) !important; }
  [data-theme="dark"] .open-to-item .oti-text strong  { color: var(--np-navy) !important; }

  @media (max-width: 600px) {
    .contact-title { font-size: 1.9rem; }
    .contact-grid  { grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr; }
  }
</style>
